_comment: Copy to state/factory.local.json (never committed) and put your own values in. .claude/scripts/lib/factory_local.py merges it over state/factory.json. mold_sources: where `mold.py fetch <mold_id>` clones each mold from. live_projects: an existing live deployment the factory must only read (optional). workspace_name and agent_cli_scope: a new application's default workspace name and the npm organisation its agent package is published under (optional; kept here because they name your organisation). legacy_names: {current: old} spellings of state keys older applications still carry (optional). sweep: this machine's own sweep choices (optional; .claude/scripts/sweep.py merges them over state/factory.json's sweep block): which apps' mold-moved redeploys are pre-approved (auto_deploy) or allowed once parity is proven (parity_deploy), and any trains or gated tickets.
